catalogPurpose: OPFG Content Bible / event authoring reference

notes: The source coordinates are Leaflet map-space coordinates, not geographic latitude/longitude.
The dump contains no usable popup descriptions, geographic coordinates, links or images for the markers.
index.html duplicates the 311 markers from index and was removed before semantic cleanup.
CSV and JSON representations were cross-checked on page/name/type/lat/lng with zero divergence.

deduplication: Collapsed repeated references to the same named location when the global map and a dedicated submap clearly referred to the same place.
Collapsed four Calm Belt markers to one regional entry.
Consolidated six split 'Red'/'Line' map labels into one Red Line regional entry.
Kept same-name locations separate when context differed (for example Gate of Justice, Main Gate, B1, Rooftop and Birka).
Excluded only two clear technical/non-location artifacts from the runtime catalogue: '100%' and 'Notice'.

provenancePolicy.source-derived: Directly present in the supplied dump.
provenancePolicy.inferred: Classification/runtime/tagging derived for OPFG from map position, page context, naming and conservative One Piece knowledge.
provenancePolicy.needs_review: Ambiguous canon status, identity, geography or marker semantics; not silently promoted.

runtimePolicy.v1: Ready location in one of the four Blues.
runtimePolicy.v1_candidate: Blue location that still requires review.
runtimePolicy.future: Non-Blue runtime-capable location reserved for later.
runtimePolicy.reference_only: Lore/authoring reference; should not become a normal runtime LocationDefinition without deliberate promotion.
